title: Tempest Delver
description: Guide Rimuru through Jura’s caverns and castle strongholds. Absorb monsters, trade magic gems and evolve between expeditions.

title: Tempest Chess
description: Take the white pieces in Rimuru’s war council. Challenge Gobta, Benimaru, or Raphael and change difficulty during the match.

title: Driftwood Isle
description: Watch the crew build a life together. Call rain, bloom, heat or gales across the island and see who thrives.

title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as Bobert
description: Clock in as Bobert, build your crew, and upgrade your impact wrench one shift at a time.

title: SohStx Pinball
description: Drop the Tempest seals and shoot the dragon chute to unleash Veldora multiball.

title: Retread Rampage
description: Clear the bays of rogue tire monsters with your tire iron and impact wrench in this Doom 95–style shooter.

title: Bobert: Night Shift
description: Jump the service pits, fight your way through the shop, and take on Big Lug.

title: Tire Shots Rival
description: Pick Hector, Erasmo, or another fighter. Throw punches, win rounds, and upgrade strength, speed and accuracy.
